problems: Elenchus prints no column for any item; every column is body-only, cross-checked against the closing Ordo Rerum, whose digits are often garbled.

Items 1-5 sit in the preliminary Roman-numeral columns; the OCR's roman page numbers are badly broken, so bodyCol is null and bodyColRoman is inferred from sequence (iii, ix, xxi, lvii, lxi), not read.
Pars secunda Notitiae (325), Novellae (419), Kapkinoi and S. Clementis (665) rest on sequence, because the page numbers in those spans are missing from the OCR.
Elenchus sub-heading 'Carmina.' under Pars tertia is treated as a section heading (no column), not an entry; the Elenchus does not list it with a column and lists the carmina individually.
Ordo prints 667 for Clementis, but its head is 52 lines before the page marker OCR'd '661' (667); unresolved whether the Ordo counts the continuation column.
